import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] nMod = readInts(sc);
        int n = nMod[0];
        int mod = nMod[1];

        int total_edges = n * (n - 1) / 2;
        int[][][] dp = new int[n + 1][total_edges + 1][n + 1];
        dp[1][0][1] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= total_edges; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    int val = dp[i][j][k];
                    if (val == 0) continue;
                    if (j + i <= total_edges && k + 1 <= n) {
                        dp[i + 1][j + i][k + 1] = (dp[i + 1][j + i][k + 1] + val) % mod;
                    }
                    for (int l = 0; l < i; l++) {
                        int newJ = j + i - 1 - l;
                        if (newJ <= total_edges) {
                            dp[i + 1][newJ][k] = (dp[i + 1][newJ][k] + val) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int[][][] S_dp = new int[n + 1][n + 1][total_edges + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
                int acc = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j <= total_edges; j++) {
                    acc = (acc + dp[i][j][k]) % mod;
                    S_dp[i][k][j] = acc;
                }
            }
        }

        int[][][] SS_dp = new int[n + 1][total_edges + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= total_edges; j++) {
                int acc = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
                    acc = (acc + S_dp[i][k][j]) % mod;
                    SS_dp[i][j][k] = acc;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] ANS = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long ans = (long) i * ANS[i - 1] % mod;
            for (int k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= total_edges; j++) {
                    if (dp[i][j][k] == 0) continue;
                    int val = SS_dp[i][j - 1][n] - SS_dp[i][j - 1][k];
                    if (val < 0) val += mod;
                    ans = (ans + (long) dp[i][j][k] * val) % mod;
                }
            }
            ANS[i] = (int) ans;
        }

        System.out.println(ANS[n]);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static int[] readInts(Scanner sc) {
        String[] parts = sc.nextLine().split(" ");
        int[] res = new int[parts.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            res[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
        }
        return res;
    }
}
